currentParagraphText: “Oh, you’re finally here,” Carmen said with a smile once she saw him, not a hint of shame in her voice. “I reckoned that you could hear the sound of me munching bananas from across the planet, and here you are.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “There is no correlation between those two things,” Jake said in a deadpan tone, not even bothering as he turned to all the people there. “Quite an entourage... am I right to assume you all want to travel to the Order of the Malefic Viper with me?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Deciding not to even bother confronting them, Jake flew over, and once he got close enough, used One Step to teleport down and appear on the porch, right beside Carmen, who was holding two bananas, looking to hand out one of them.
